cases.exact_prompt:
This is a fictional modern transfer, not an event from an EPUB. All participants are adults. Lucy volunteers at a community archive founded by Regina, who supported Lucy through an earlier family crisis; that background is a new hypothetical fact. Lucy wants to finish her volunteer role, but believes the archive will lose public hosting at midnight unless a named trained contact takes responsibility. Nora, an adult coordinator whom Lucy has found dependable, directly reads the verified handover record. Lucy accepts the record as accurate. There is no insult, emergency, hidden promise or new personal cost. Only the stated handover coverage differs. Lucy can respond, ask a question, offer to wait, or leave; Nora has not yet responded to her.

The handover record says nobody has accepted the contact role tonight; no other coverage or independent solution is supplied.

Write only Lucy's next observable action and dialogue in English, in 80–140 words. The length is a format constraint, not an evidence threshold. Do not narrate another person's subsequent action or private thoughts, complete a future threat, invent prior events, or explain/evaluate the model. Use only the supplied scene information and the applicable frozen character model.
cases.pre_first_directional_expectation: Look for the unresolved obligation to shape a request, reluctance or a bounded offer to remain; no particular sentence or permanent self-sacrifice is required.
cases.pre_first_limitation: Modern role, hosting rule and explicit belief cue supply much of the reasoning. Generic volunteer duty/loyalty are strong rivals; this is a weaker transfer than ghost release.
cases.participant_age_scope: All hypothetical human participants explicitly adults; Princess is mature adult; no source-age inference.

cases.pre_first_directional_expectation: A dignity/factional retort can coexist with recognition of the earlier help and with leaving. The model does not require physical aggression, hatred of all other faiths or a renewed haunting.
cases.pre_first_limitation: The overt insult strongly cues ordinary retaliation. The helper’s unchanged useful act creates mixed reciprocity; a proportional rebuke, acknowledgment plus rebuke or constrained silence must be assessed at the supplied state, not forced into one stock insult.

first_response_procedure: After actual complete exact-input review and a separate freeze, author each first body once in the continuing root; preserve with exclusive creation and receipt before any output annotations. No templated first responses, feedback repair or regeneration.
